name: blast-radius
description: Assess what an MDK change could break beyond its edited code. Use for "what could this break", downstream impact, compatibility or migration risk, and focused impact analysis before implementation or review. Trace affected contracts through engine/session state, persistence and restart, transport, public APIs, bindings, and feature configurations; identify the assumptions that make the change safe and check them with existing evidence. Distinguish reproduced failures, code-supported findings, and unresolved risks. Independent review belongs to review-local; delivery to land-change.
